rule_reasons.policy:aggregate: aggregate scores or pre-registered gate results
rule_reasons.policy:campaign-report: campaign report or decision boundary record
rule_reasons.policy:case-register: case register defining what the campaign tested; report claims are unverifiable without it
rule_reasons.policy:decision-boundary: records why a run was discarded
rule_reasons.policy:duplicated: duplicated schema or telemetry; the same content is retained elsewhere or is regenerable from tracked code
rule_reasons.policy:fingerprint: fingerprint identifying runner, fixture, prompt, model, or code lineage
rule_reasons.policy:manifest: run or contamination manifest supporting a stated claim
rule_reasons.policy:per-call: per-call prompt, answer, event stream, stderr, or judge intermediate record
rule_reasons.unmatched: no rule matched; kept by default and requires explicit human classification
